implementation_scope: add an opt-in finite-file terminal-drain mode to the receiver input valve
on configured source exhaustion, return natural GNU Radio end-of-stream and request a drain action instead of the immediate STOP action
handle the drain action by waiting for natural flowgraph completion before normal shutdown
enable the mode identically in all frozen R2c cleanStatic, DS3, and OS3 receiver configs
preserve the R2b handoff restore, TRACE schema-v2 serialization, causal action mapping, score adapter, and evaluator unchanged
phase_b_authorization_rule: Authorize Phase B only if every unchanged frozen Phase A source, executable/config/patch/handoff hash, cadence, causal, support, whole-row-set, terminal-count, semantic-hash, score, block-key, threshold-crossing, alarm, raw-timeline, and action-mapping gate passes.
row_closure_policy: Do not filter or suppress native rows or TRACE pairs post hoc. The finite source closes at its already frozen source-bound end sample. After the last configured item is copied, propagate GNU Radio WORK_DONE and wait for every downstream block to consume all schedulable buffered input before stopping channels. The unchanged adapter then forms only naturally emitted, fully linked causal pairs.
success_prediction: With identical input count and channel initial state, natural EOS propagation leaves each tracking block with a deterministic terminal buffer smaller than its forecast requirement. rep3 and rep4 should therefore emit identical per-PRN/channel terminal rows without changing any common physical value.
